title: On Wandering along the shore for hours
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：wander　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wander 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the herder ① wandered along the shore for hours in public, and every neighbour in the pasture said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three winters on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the herder ② wanders along the shore for hours in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ wander along the shore for hours at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ wandered along the shore for hours before — a line in the ledger for December 1971 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Wandering along the shore for hours in public, the herder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far pen, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ wander from the point in his talk in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Wander from the point in his talk at once and never mention it again.

By 1984 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new neighbour from the next pasture ⑧ wanders from the point in his talk in public every winter without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the pen, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ wandered along the shore for hours again when nobody else would.

⑩ To wander along the shore for hours, my mother said in 1989, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the pasture remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the pasture forgets, somebody wanders along the shore for hours in silence again and somebody must wander along the shore for hours in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 漫游（一般过去式 wandered along the shore for hours：1977 年牧人头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 漫游（一般现在 wanders along the shore for hours：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 漫游（不定式 to wander along the shore for hours：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 漫游（过去完成时 had wandered along the shore for hours：1971 年十二月的牧群台账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 漫游（动名词 wandering along the shore for hours 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 偏离（wander from the point in his talk：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去偏离讲话时离了题）
G. v. 偏离（wander from the point in his talk：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 漫游（后段两处：新来的邻人照例 wanders from the point in his talk，而母亲又一次 wandered along the shore for hours）

answers.why: wander 意为“漫游”，1977 年牧人当着众人面漫游在岸边漫游了几个钟头，那是牧场里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 wandered。
wander 意为“漫游”，自那以后牧人一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 wanders。
wander 意为“漫游”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯漫游在岸边漫游了几个钟头”，此处为不定式 to wander along the shore for hours。
wander 意为“漫游”，牧群台账里 十二月 那行字说明早在 1984 年之前就有人漫游过，故用过去完成时 had wandered。
wander 意为“漫游”，牧人说“漫游在岸边漫游了几个钟头这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 wandering along the shore for hours 作主语。
wander 意为“偏离”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去偏离讲话时离了题”，should ever 之后用原形 wander from the point in his talk。
wander 意为“偏离”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻偏离讲话时离了题（wander from the point in his talk at once），以后再也不要提起。
wander 意为“漫游”，新来的邻人每个冬天都照例偏离讲话时离了题，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 wanders。
wander 意为“漫游”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面漫游在岸边漫游了几个钟头，用一般过去式 wandered 叙述。
wander 意为“漫游”，结尾那句是母亲 1989 年的话：要漫游在岸边漫游了几个钟头，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和牧场记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用

items: 1977 年，牧人当着众人面漫游在岸边漫游了几个钟头；牧场里每一个邻人都说这是头一回。（wandered along the shore for hours）
多年以后，牧人仍一言不发地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（wanders along the shore for hours）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯漫游在岸边漫游了几个钟头这件事本身。（to wander along the shore for hours）
早在 1971 年就有人漫游在岸边漫游了几个钟头，十二月那天牧群台账上的一行字就是证据。（had wandered along the shore for hours）
牧人说过，当着众人面漫游在岸边漫游了几个钟头这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（wandering along the shore for hours 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻偏离讲话时离了题，以后再也不要提起。（wander from the point in his talk，祈使句）
answers: In 1977 the herder wandered along the shore for hours in public, and every neighbour in the pasture said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three winters on, the herder still wanders along the shore for hours in silence without being asked.

Somebody had wandered along the shore for hours long before 1984, and the line in the ledger for December proves it.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 wander 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1977 the herder wandered along the shore for hours in public, and nobody in the pasture forgot it.
Even now the herder wanders along the shore for hours in silence whenever the pasture asks.
Wandering along the shore for hours in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever wander from the point in his talk in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new neighbour from the next pasture wanders from the point in his talk in public every winter, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother wandered along the shore for hours again, and the pasture remembered that half.
